title: Recording: Angel Baby by John Lennon | 1973
content:
A&M Studios, Los Angeles
Producers: John Lennon, Phil Spector

John Lennon recorded ‘Angel Baby’ for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 20 October 1973.

The song was written by Rosie Hamlin, and first released as a 1960 single by Rosie & The Originals. At the time Hamlin was 15 years old, and the doo-wop recording was made on a two-track machine in an aircraft hanger.

This here is one of my all-time favourite songs. Send my love to Rosie, wherever she may be.
John Lennon
‘Angel Baby’

‘Angel Baby’ was left off Rock ‘N’ Roll, although it did appear on the unofficial album Roots: John Lennon Sings The Great Rock & Roll Hits, issued by Morris Levy in January 1975. It received an official release on the 1986 posthumous collection Menlove Ave, on which it was edited to increase the length by more than 30 seconds.
